messages:
sasha: Quick check — SOC2 fieldwork next Tue. We have a KMS/HSM *stub validation* pass scheduled. Need to confirm owners for: 1) audit-log ingestion proof, 2) keystore rotation smoke, 3) HSM attestation run. Who's taking what?

kevin: I can own audit-log ingestion proof. I'll validate S3 hooks + idempotency.

priya: I'll take keystore rotation smoke. Plan to run a dry rotate in staging and attach logs to the evidence folder.

jordan: I can do HSM attestation run but need someone from infra to open the HSM console access window. @kevin can you coordinate?

kevin: Yep, infra flagged a maintenance window Tue 09:30-10:30 PT. I'll ping infra and add the access token TTL to the checklist.

sasha: Nice. Couple of quick asks: please add PR/CL links and the minimal repro command to the evidence doc. Example command I used for audit logs:

```
curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVIDENCE_TOKEN" 
  -F "file=@/tmp/audit-sample.json" 
  https://evidence.redwood.example/api/v1/ingest
```

That should be runnable by the auditor with a temporary token.

priya: putting the smoke test steps in the doc now. Adding a note: rotation dry-run uses `keystorectl rotate --dry-run --env=staging` and captures stdout/stderr.

jordan: infra confirmed. infra-bot created a short-lived role and I added the role ARN to the playbook. Also noted that HSM networking requires whitelisting the auditor IPs.

ci-bot: deploy succeeded for branch `soc2/kms-stubs` — build #7842 — staging env updated.

kevin: two blockers I see: 1) audit-log backfill job still impacts throughput (need a rate cap), 2) evidence bucket ACLs need a stricter policy so third-party upload works but listing is blocked. I'll open PRs for both.

sasha: Great — please link PR numbers here. Also, for ownership clarity: audit-log ingestion => kevin (owner), keystore rotation => priya (owner), HSM attestation => jordan (owner). I'll be backup for all three.

priya: PR created for keystore evidence doc changes: https://git.redwood/infradocs/pulls/412 (includes commands + expected output).

kevin: PRs: rate cap for backfill https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/2187, evidence-bucket ACL https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/2188. Both aim to be merged by EOD Mon.

jordan: added auditor IPs to the HSM playbook and bumped the runbook version to v1.3 in Confluence.

sasha: Perfect. Last thing — please add a short checklist item in the playbook: 1) create temp token, 2) run ingest command above, 3) confirm S3 put metrics, 4) attach logs. We'll hand this to the auditor during the fieldwork slot.

kevin: will update checklist and tag @sasha when done.

priya: I'll run the dry rotate Tue morning and paste output to the evidence doc.

sasha: Thanks team :thumbsup: — will compile the handover doc tonight and share the final link in this thread.
